description: Add optional Swarm Manager integration to Git Control Tower. When Vrooli-Initiative trailer is present and Swarm Manager is available, fetch initiative description and backlog items for rich context. Same graceful degradation pattern as other GCT optional dependencies (tidiness-manager, test-genie, etc.). If Swarm Manager unavailable, group by trailer value without enrichment. If no trailers, standard commit message only.
name: gct-swarm-manager-integration
title: Optional Swarm Manager client for initiative enrichment on trailer-linked commits
